Anticipating a long wait, took a book with me. Was first in the queue, and there were 2 people after me. The person behind me asked if I can read Chinese, an odd conversation starter.

He then pointed to the book I was holding. The cover had the prominent title, `史記 사기- Shiji`

> Oh, I don't read Chinese, but I can speak some Korean.

To my surprise he said he studied in Korea and received his PhD from 전북 University back in 1960s.

He was involved in Peace Corp and it led to him to Korea.

Then 처재's in-laws came. It turns out Robert Norton studied at their hometown of 전주.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hiked Rock Canyon with Sister K's sister and her husband.

Met, prior to the split.

Hi (Former) Bishop.

Great to be recognized, no prompt, just immediate response.
